description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
